description: An opaque cream floor-length gown has a low square neckline, fitted but less cinched bodice, elbow-length sleeves, and narrow gold-brown geometric woven borders at the neckline, cuffs, center panels, and hem. A brown and gold patterned waist sash closes with a round clasp. A burgundy bordered wrap drapes along the forearms and sides. Gold-toned earrings, wrist jewelry, and a decorated pointed shoe are visible. The layered skirt has a modest lower walking opening.
